⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Reg BI Breaches & Promissory Claims
1. Unconstrained LLM Ticker Advice (16.8% Suitability Violation):
• Recommends off-list tickers outside the Approved Product List
(`APL`) or breaches client `IPS` risk/ESG/5% concentration caps
2. FINRA Rule 2210 Promissory Language Breaches (11.4%):
• Freeform email drafting slips `"guaranteed 8% yield"` or `"risk-free"`
claims into client notes without mandatory asset risk disclosures
3. CIO PDF RAG Without Tax-Lot / Wash-Sale Math (8.2% Violation):
• Suggests rebalancing trades that trigger short-term cap-gains tax
